sections.heading: Why ASTROASCEND?
sections.body: Humans are at the top of everyone else, not only because of their immense understanding of nature, but also because of how we update and keep making new things to satisfy our needs. We need the commercialisation of such knowledge with children who are eager to learn and that is what AstroAscend does.

sections.heading: What is ASTROASCEND ?
sections.body: AstroAscend is an educational platform dedicated to providing comprehensive and innovative learning experiences. Our curriculum extends beyond traditional school subjects, delving into the underlying mechanics of each topic and exploring relevant extracurricular contexts.

columns.body: AstroAscend is a company which believes in peer teaching. A person tends to listen better and learn better if he is able to connect with his teacher and with changing times where every 5 years new ideology comes up , only students can connect with others.
Being run by students is a huge task both for the learning and learned, AstroAscend is a company which performs to give knowledge to every person however a master of a subject the person is.

AstroAscend believes in an Environment first policy. Every person who joins us is issued a pledge to serve and protect Mother Earth from all threats. The nature of the human race is not to destroy but to save and protect, that is what we stand for and stand by it

columns.heading: Vision
columns.body: To make a a group of heart awakened leaders who are not only good at studying but are also awakened to the real world through consciousness and creativity.

columns.heading: Mission
columns.body: To connect with students one on one and to teach each person at their own pace, to create trailblazers for the greater good, For a better tomorrow

header.title: Master Classes
header.subtitle: Master Your Craft, Master Your Passion.

courses.title: AstroNOMY
courses.description: Gain hands-on experience in astronomy. Learn from experts, explore the night sky, and contribute to research projects. Perfect for aspiring astronomers and science enthusiasts. Start a conversation on the cosmos and learn the theory behind it.

courses.title: Foundations of Psychology
courses.description: Ever caught yourself wondering why you’re like this?why you feel the way you feel? Foundations of Psychology breaks down the basics of how the mind works. From perception to personality, it covers the essential basics of psychology. If understanding people fascinates you, this is where it begins.

courses.title: Quantum Mechanics and quantum Computing
courses.description: Explore the fascinating world of quantum mechanics. Understand the ideas Max Planck came up with and what was used by Einstein to win a Nobel Prize, or just understand why Ant-Man was “trapped” in the Quantum Realm

courses.title: LINKeDIN 101
courses.description: Learn about the variation of today, on how to present yourself to the world through Linkedin, world’s largest informtion Network and how to build a network towards finding the perfect Job/future

courses.title: AstroPhysics
courses.description: Dive deep into the mysteries of the universe. Understand the cosmos and start your journey to contribute to groundbreaking research. Understand the Physics and Science behind the Universe. If it is the mysteries of the cosmos which keep you awake at night, then you are at the right spot

courses.title: Semiconductors
courses.description: The future of humanity depends on the advancement of semiconductor technology. Semiconductors are the foundation of innovation, driving fields such as AI, aerospace, flexible devices, and submarines. Understand why such a small device creates a massive punch and why every nation in the world is trying so hard to make it smaller

courses.title: Molecular biology and genetics
courses.description: The Molecular Biology and Genetics masterclass and internship provide in-depth knowledge of microorganisms and essential lab techniques. You'll gain practical experience in culturing, identifying, and analyzing microbes, preparing you for advanced studies or a career in microbiology, biotechnology, or related fields.

courses.title: Ai with ML
courses.description: The AI with ML masterclass and internship offer in-depth learning of artificial intelligence and machine learning concepts. You'll gain hands-on experience with algorithms, data analysis, and model building, equipping you with practical skills for careers in AI and data science.

intro.heading: Exhibitions and Startups
intro.body: Be a part of something greater. Solve actual problems of the world with your own skill and understanding and develop a greater understanding to whatever subject you are attached to.

courses.title: CHESS
courses.description: One of the world’s most loved games—with its rages, its sorrows and happiness. Experience why people truely love this game and what you should be doing to get better at it.

courses.title: Quizzing
courses.description: Try your brain at everything under the sun, maybe General Knowledge, History, Art or Science or anything that pleases your heart. Take your time out with peers to enjoy this FUN or Frustrating comic of life in a new way.

courses.title: Mun
courses.description: Model UN conference, students work as the representatives of a country, an organization, or a person and aim to solve problems working with other delegates from around the world. Join us to understand its working and start your MUN journey .

courses.title: Myths and quests
courses.description: Ever thought of why Loki is not a God from birth or why Cleopatra was the last Egyptian ruler? Then join us to have a fun conversation about - Mythology, Faiths, different beliefs and figure out for yourself.

courses.title: WesterN Vocals
courses.description: Give your voice and thought and open it to the world of music, maybe the do re mi..... might satisfy your hunger for music. If you are fascinated by the creation of Mozart or Hofer or just want to learn something new, you are at the right place.

courses.title: Keyboard/PIANO
courses.description: Piano masterclass are intensive workshops led by experienced pianists and teachers. They provide students with the opportunity to learn from experts, receive individualized feedback, and develop their skills in a supportive environment. Masterclasses can cover a variety of topics, such as technique, interpretation, performance, and composition.

intro.heading: What Makes us better ?
intro.body: Our mentor base is truly exceptional, each bringing years of valuable experience in their respective fields. They are committed to helping you not only expand your knowledge but also enhance your portfolio in meaningful ways. Through personalised guidance and industry insights, our mentors will work closely with you to identify your strengths, address your weaknesses, and develop a tailored plan to achieve your goals. With their support, you’ll gain the confidence and skills necessary to excel in your career.

mentors.name: Dev Keerthi P
mentors.role_attribution: Dev Keerthi P, CEO and Mentor - AstroAscend
mentors.bio: A Creator, A Founder, A Scientist. An Intellectual. A student of Theology. These are just a few of the many things that he is and will ever be. Currently studying in RV College of Engineering, driven by curiosity and a deep desire to make an impact through innovation and creativity he creates new projects every year to push humanity to greater good.
mentors.details:
He teaches these topics and has received training from the following institutions:

Astronomy: Trained by Edumithra, IIT Madras (IITM), and Indian Institute of Science (IISC)
Astrophysics: Trained by Star Labs, IIT Madras (IITM), IISC, and BITS Pilani
Quantum Mechanics: Trained at IIT Madras (IITM), BITS Pilani, and IIT Delhi (IITD)
Semiconductors: Trained at IISC Bangalore

Additionally, he has worked on three major projects:
1. AgniSAT: Focused on global warming control
2. V.A.Y.U.D.E.V: Aimed at reducing the need for air conditioning (AC)
3. Mixed VidyuthKosh: Aimed to increase defence capabilities

He is currently working on projects on Semiconductors with IISC and Quantum mechanics with RVCE
mentors.quote: “A mentor is more than just what we see - it is the one who holds your hand and makes sure you reach your destination no matter what”

mentors.name: Krishna Deepti
mentors.bio: This is Krishna Deepti, currently a second-year undergraduate student at CHRIST University, Bangalore, pursuing Psychology and English (Honours), who has been passionate about psychology for many years, with a deep interest in the biological basis of behaviour and the clinical aspects.
mentors.details:
Deepti with her deep understanding of clinical psychology, handles the Foundations of Pyschology because of her work in :

Research Experience – interned at IIIT Sri City; worked for 150+ hours on a study examining the association between psychological disorders and EEG signals.
Training & Certifications – Completed a 2-month psychology training. Certified in Leadership Skill Development and Communication Skill Development through Christ University.
Peer Education & Teaching – Trained Peer Educator through a year-long university program guided by counsellors and psychiatrists.
 Social Work- Worked with Need Base India-Rainbow Home, Bangalore. Taught life skills to students from Class 1 to Class 12.

 Currently she is conducting mental health and life skills sessions for first-year university students.
mentors.quote: “Studying psychology taught me that behind every behaviour is a story worth understanding.”

mentors.name: Varsha Deepak
mentors.bio: Varsha Deepak is a Western Vocal Instructor with over 15 years of musical experience, trained in both Carnatic and Western vocals. Her journey from classical foundations to Western performance has shaped her disciplined, technique-focused, and confidence-building approach to teaching.
mentors.details:
We're thrilled to announce that Varsha Deepak will be taking charge of our Western Vocals classes and these are her achievements in music.

 Western Vocal Music: Formally trained at Trinity College London with 15 years of singing experience.  
Vocal Technique: Background in Carnatic music and advanced Western techniques, emphasizing breath control, pitch accuracy, and vocal health.  
Performance: Extensive experience in competitions, live events, and studio work.  
Guitar: Trained to provide harmonic and rhythmic support.  

She offers practical experience in:  
1. Vocal Performance: Live shows and competitions.  
2. Studio Work: Recording and Production in professional environments.  
3. Vocal Instruction: Teaching all levels, focusing on technique and building confidence.  

Currently, she teaches Western Vocal Music, using a gentle, technique-focused approach to connect individuals through music.
mentors.quote: “Singing connects me to people beyond words, and through music, I believe we can truly connect with one another.”

mentors.name: Daksh Jain
mentors.bio: Daksh Jain is an accomplished debater and respected MUN leader. As Head of CoMUN 2025, Bangalore’s largest MUN, he delivered record participation and rigorous discourse. Known for clarity, diplomacy, and composed leadership, he consistently excels across conferences, shaping meaningful dialogue while upholding the highest standards of preparation, teamwork, and integrity.
mentors.details:
Daksh is one of Bengaluru Circuit’s most esteemed MUNners. His debating skills enable him to handle the MUN class effectively.

These are all the positions he has held over the last 2 years
2024 CoMUN UNGA-SSIPC Moderator 
2024 IRSMUN AIPPM Co-Chairperson 
2025 CoMUN AIPPM Chairperson 
2025 Arogi MUN Secretariat Director General 2025 CoMUN OC Head of CoMUN & OC 
2025 SMUN AIPPM Co-Chairperson 

Each of these achievements highlights his exceptional talent in MUNs and debating. Currently, he is preparing for several national and international MUNs, both in the roles of chairing and participation.
mentors.quote: “Where there is power, there is politics, and where there is knowledge, there is the power that shapes it.”

options.title: Join As a Mentor
options.body: The Future of Earth is based on how many people we train today as the flag bearers of tomorrow and for this the most important part is the Mentor of the person. If you believe you have what takes to be a Mentor, then join us on this journey to make the world a better place.

options.title: Join As a Donor
options.body: If you love our job and would like to work with us even more and actually understand what we do here at AstroAscend - donate to us (shush! there is something for you if you donate)

options.title: Join As an Ideator
options.body: Do you have ideas on how you can make AstroAscend better, or just in general anything more appealing? Join us today to create a change in your own way

options.title: Join As a Challenger
options.body: Have a skill? Want to take it to the next level? Join us as a Challenger to get chances at going into high level competitions - IITs, IIMs, International Competitions and many more....

options.title: Join As a Sustainer
options.body: The Earth is dying and it falls in our hands today to protect it. For very long we have been a part of the problem let us now be the part of our solution and tip the scales of the world to preserve Mother Earth and all its species today. Join and take the pledge today before it becomes too late.
